title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
The honest version of Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine starts by giving up the comforting part. Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine is a 2011 third-person shooter hack and slash video game developed by Relic Entertainment and published by THQ. The game was released for PlayStation 3, Windows, and Xbox 360 in North America, Australia, and Europe in September 2011.

Every serious account of Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. And one has to question the wisdom of releasing in such close proximity to Gears of War 3. On December 9, 2021 Saber Interactive and Focus Entertainment announced Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 with a cinematic trailer.
